explication: Dotcom is the MBTA’s public transit website. A rider request enters the Phoenix router, reaches a page or live interface, and is resolved using schedules, stops, fares, CMS content, search, or real-time predictions before HTML, JSON, or PubSub updates return to the browser. The tree and excerpts clearly show these boundaries; several controller integrations and alert paths were not sampled, so those relationships are intentionally conservative.
